items.briefing:
Australia and New Zealand are facing a spike in critical software vulnerabilities, coinciding with a global campaign exploiting a serious flaw in VMware vCenter — widely used server management software. Ransomware attacks surged in July, and AI is making cybercrime faster and easier for attackers to execute at scale. While ransomware victim numbers have stabilised, the number of active criminal groups is at a record high, meaning the threat remains very real for Australian organisations of all sizes.

**Practical tip:** Ensure your IT team is aware of any VMware or Windows software requiring urgent patching this week — delays in applying updates are a common way attackers gain entry.

featured.title: Australia & New Zealand face surge in critical flaws
featured.quote: Critical patch backlogs expose Australian organisations to immediate security breaches across 85 high-impact vulnerabilities.
